Field Synth.name: Dual Oscillator Pad
Field Synth.code:
param float detune = 1.008 [1.0, 1.03]
param float cutoff = 2800.0 [200.0, 10000.0]
param float res = 0.35 [0.0, 0.92]
param float sub = 0.30 [0.0, 1.0]
param float warmth = 0.40 [0.0, 1.0]
param float attack = 0.05 [0.005, 0.5]
state float p1 = 0
state float p2 = 0
state float pSub = 0
state float env = 0
state float lp = 0

spread = sqrt(detune)
p1 = (p1 + (freq / spread) / sr) % 1.0
p2 = (p2 + (freq * spread) / sr) % 1.0
pSub = (pSub + (freq * 0.5) / sr) % 1.0

target = if(gate > 0.5, 1.0, 0.0)
rate = if(target > env, clamp(1.0 / (sr * max(attack, 0.005)), 0.0001, 0.1), 0.0005)
env = env + (target - env) * rate

tone = sin(6.283185 * p1) * 0.45 + sin(6.283185 * p2) * 0.45 + sin(6.283185 * pSub) * sub
drive = 1.0 + warmth * 1.5
u = clamp(tone * drive * 0.5, -1.5, 1.5)
sat = (u - u * u * u * 0.148148) * 1.25

f = clamp((cutoff / sr) * 3.14159, 0.001, 0.95)
lp = lp + f * (sat - lp)
filt = lp + (sat - lp) * (1.0 - res)
out = filt * env * 0.33

Field Synth.name: Resonant String Pluck
Field Synth.code:
param float damp = 0.35 [0.05, 0.95]
param float brightness = 2.5 [1.0, 8.0]
param float decay = 1.8 [0.2, 5.0]
param float body = 0.40 [0.0, 1.0]
param float strike = 0.90 [0.1, 2.0]
state float pInit = 0
state float s1 = 0
state float s2 = 0
state float bodyPhase = 0

exciter = if(gate > 0.5 && pInit < 1.0, strike, 0.0)
pInit = if(gate > 0.5, pInit + 1.0, 0.0)

w = 6.2831853 * clamp(freq, 20.0, sr * 0.45) / sr
dRate = clamp(1.0 / (sr * max(decay, 0.1)), 0.00002, 0.01)
dCoeff = clamp(1.0 - dRate - damp * 0.004, 0.95, 0.9999)

cosW = cos(w)
sinW = sin(w)
next1 = (s1 * cosW - s2 * sinW + exciter) * dCoeff
next2 = (s1 * sinW + s2 * cosW) * dCoeff

s1 = next1 / (1.0 + abs(next1) * 0.02)
s2 = next2 / (1.0 + abs(next2) * 0.02)

stringSig = s1 * brightness
bodyPhase = (bodyPhase + 110.0 / sr) % 1.0
bodyRes = sin(6.283185 * bodyPhase) * abs(s1) * body

out = (stringSig + bodyRes) * gate

param float cutoff = 2200.0 [100.0, 12000.0]
param float res = 0.65 [0.0, 0.95]
param float sub = 0.35 [0.0, 1.0]
param float drive = 1.80 [1.0, 5.0]

rawSub = subPhase * 2.0 - 1.0

u = sat - fb

lp2 = lp2 + f * (lp1 - lp2)
